name: dark spirit
description: Evil entity that possessed Ebnezzer, then the lake's waters, then Winton.

description_citations.text: "Tayva and Loria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The World Spell drains the cousins' power and leaves Ebnezzer possessed by a dark spirit.
timeline.quote: leaving Ebnezzer possessed by a dark spirit

citation.text: "Tayva and Loria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They kill Ebnezzer and put his head into a lake, where the spirit takes possession of the waters.
timeline.quote: They killed Ebnezzer and took his head with them north into the backwoods.

citation.text: "Tayva and Loria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The undead Winton, possessed by the lake spirit, drags both cousins into the waters.
timeline.quote: The lake spirit did not want either of the cousins to leave the swamp and dragged them both into the waters.
